plan.headline: Quiet Tuesday with a stacked 9:30 to 11 PM let-out window: Lila Downs at the Moore, Iron & Wine at the 5th Avenue, Mon Rovia at Showbox SoDo and Young Miko at Climate Pledge. Best windows are 3 to 6:30 PM in the city and SEA, then the evening SEA arrival peak into the let-outs.

blocks.play: Skip the morning and midday. SEA departures hold steady at about 40 an hour, not a spike worth an early start.

Work downtown, SLU and First Hill pickups and take a downtown to SEA trip if one comes. If the SEA queue is short around 4 PM grab an arrival back into the city; otherwise head north to Georgetown or SoDo.
Eat in the city. Be rolling again by 7:15.

Catch the 7 to 8 PM SEA arrival peak and bring a passenger back into Seattle. From 9:30 work the let-outs in order: the Moore (about 9:45), the 5th Avenue and Comedy Underground (10 to 10:15), then Showbox SoDo, the Capitol Hill clubs and Young Miko fans on the arena edges (10:45).

notes: SEA arrivals peak at 7 PM (48 flights) and 8 PM (42).
Small conferences only (Seattle Convention Center, morning); no hotel-trip effect.
Cruise season is over until spring.
